title: The Sanctuary Arts Centre

services.name: Annex Rentals
services.desc: This space sits below the Sanctuary Hall ("Downstairs at the Sanctuary") and offers 2000 sqft of creative space and its own restroom facilities. Located on the Ochterloney Street level of the Sanctuary Arts Centre, our Annex offers plenty of bright, easy-to-access space to create and collaborate. Our accessible Annex space is decked in 1090 sqft of hardwood and located next to the Sanctuary Hall. The space can fit 100 guests seated or standing.
